description.fun: Snorunt live in groups of five, sheltering together under giant leaves and surviving on snow and ice in temperatures as low as about −100 °C. Legend says any home a Snorunt visits will prosper for generations, so people leave out lumps of ice made from pure water for it. If one shows up at night, heavy snow is said to follow by morning.
description.guide: An Ice-type Pokémon based on yukiwarashi, childlike snow spirits of Japanese folklore, wearing a cloak like a straw snow cape. It lives in caves. It evolves into Glalie at level 42 or, if female, into Froslass with a Dawn Stone.
description.tagline: A lucky little snow spirit that brings prosperity and snowfall

branches.text: Snorunt becomes Glalie at level 42, but a female Snorunt exposed to a Dawn Stone becomes Froslass instead. Male Snorunt can only become Glalie.

description.fun: Legend says Glalie was born from a boulder that soaked up the despair of climbers lost on icy mountains. Its rock body isn't especially hard, but it freezes the moisture in the air into armour harder than steel and can shape ice however it likes. It freezes its prey before swallowing it whole. Its English name joins 'glacier' and 'goalie', after its ice-hockey-mask face.
description.guide: An Ice-type Pokémon with a rock core covered in ice, resembling a mask, which can freeze moisture in the air into any shape. It evolves from Snorunt at level 42 and can Mega Evolve with the Glalitite.
description.tagline: A floating ice mask born from lost climbers' regrets

description.fun: Mega Evolution's overwhelming energy breaks Glalie's jaw, so its mouth gapes the full length of its face and pours out endless blizzards. It's irritated that it can no longer eat its prey, and anything it throws into that mouth freezes instantly. Places where it appears are left completely white.

Legend says Froslass formed when the lingering spirit of a woman lost in the mountains possessed an icicle. It lives in snowy caves, freezes foes with breath at −50 °C and lines its frozen victims up neatly back home. On nights of fierce blizzards it comes down to knock on people's doors. Every Froslass is female, and it's based on the yuki-onna, the snow woman of Japanese folklore.
description.guide: An Ice- and Ghost-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, based on the yuki-onna of Japanese folklore and always female. It evolves from a female Snorunt with a Dawn Stone and can Mega Evolve with the Froslassite.
description.tagline: A kimono-clad snow spirit that knocks on doors in blizzards

description.fun: Mega Froslass, added in Legends: Z-A, grows taller and more regal, with a long kimono trailing ice crystals and a cloud beneath it to float on. Its cold air is laced with ghostly energy, letting it freeze even things that can't be touched, like wind and flames, and it can teleport by vanishing into the shadows. Its look may draw on the fairy tale The Snow Queen.
